policyVersions.summary: Replaces 2026-11-draft. Adds the link a sign-up came through and its use (counting sign-ups per link), the visit measurement with Plausible and the language cookie, messages by WhatsApp or e-mail, Plausible among the providers, the full rights with who attends them and the terms, the list's lifetime with a yearly reminder, the privacy address and the effective date. The consent wording is unchanged.
policyVersions.subjectsTold: Nobody yet: not published. Whether anyone is on the list under 2026-11-draft is open (check-subscribers-before-publish).

The consent names the foundation as responsible for OPTA and does not name the per-link sign-up count; the authorization must name all specific purposes (Decree 1074, art. 2.2.2.25.2.2). A draft was sent to the owner
